facts.fact: An engineering college's AICTE approval can be checked in AICTE's list of approved institutions (AICTE dashboard of approved institutes, searchable by State, programme and level)
facts.note: On 28 Oct 2026 aicte.gov.in served only a 'down for maintenance' page (its inner pages 404) and aicte-india.org / facilities.aicte-india.org reset the checker's connection. Retried 28 Oct 2026 13:35-13:40 IST (second reader): aicte.gov.in still 'down for maintenance', /education/institutions 404, aicte-india.org and facilities.aicte-india.org still reset the connection; PIB has only a 2019 note on AICTE's unapproved-institutes list. A person should open the approved-institutes list once the site is back.

summary: AICTE approved-institutes search is the right route, but every AICTE site was down or blocked for the checker on 28 Oct 2026; marked manual.
